title: Masu Gaskiya a Makkah
intro: A farkon zamanin wahayi, lokacin da saƙon gaskiya ya fuskanci adawa mai tsanani, wasu rayuka sun tsaya cak a cikin imaninsu. Waɗannan masu bi sun fuskanci zalunci mara misaltuwa daga waɗanda suka nemi kashe hasken imani. Azabarsu ta yi tsanani, wahalarsu ta yi yawa—duk da haka harsunansu ba su daina shelar kaɗaita Allah ba. Ko da aka jefa su cikin zurfin yanke ƙauna, kariyar Allah ta kewaye su, ta mayar da jarabawarsu zuwa wasiyyar imani ta har abada. Bari mu bincika tafiyar waɗannan rayuka masu ban mamaki.
clues: An jarabce mu da azaba mai tsanani saboda ƙin barin imaninmu ga Allah Ɗaya
Mutanenmu ba za su iya karya ƙudurinmu ba, komai yadda muguntarsu ta zama mai ƙirƙira
An dakatar da mu daga rijiya kowace rana, duk da haka taimakon Allah yana kusa koyaushe
Haƙurinmu ya ba wa waɗanda suka shaida juriyarmu mamaki har ma da waɗanda suka shaida juriyarmu
Mutane da yawa a Makkah sun nemi tilasta mana mu janye, amma mun ci gaba da jajircewa.
Lokacin da komai ya yi kamar an ɓata mana rai, 'yancinmu ya zo ta hanyar shiga tsakani na allahntaka ta hanyar mu'ujiza

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Tsanantawa saboda ƙin bauta wa gumaka
Gwajin imani game da lamarin gobarar
Gwajin tafiyar dare da aka raba
trial.answer: Tsanantawa saboda ƙin bauta wa gumaka

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: 'Yanci ta hanyar shiga tsakani na Allah
outcome.answer: 'Yanci ta hanyar shiga tsakani na Allah
